caseName: National Life & Accident Insurance v. Notter
caseNameFull: National Life & Accident Insurance Co. v. Notter

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. Civ. App. Tex., 10th Sup. Jud. Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
